domain: half of one 600-cell tetrahedron: beta >= 0, beta3 >= beta4 (barycentric on cell_vertices); 1200 copies tile S^3 once

files.group.json / group.npz: the 1200 elements, cell frame, multiplication and inverse tables, the 2400 beta maps (G and G.Q)
files.surface_library.json: every surface (plane or polynomial in beta) crossing the domain
files.pieces.json: arrangement pieces in the domain: sign vector, region, neighbours
files.regions.json: regions on the sphere: components, orbits, boundaries
files.walls.json: walls on the sphere: patches, components
files.lines.json / points.json: lines and points carried to every copy
files.components.npz: region_component[copy, piece], wall_component[copy, patch], face_component[copy, patch]
files.faces.json: faces: wall sheet pieces between region components, with outlines and the congruence test
files.edges.json: edges (exact curves between corners) and corners
files.line_pieces.json: atlas lines split into pieces by the edges they lie on
